answer: In our Proof of Agent network, nodes audit peer interactions through topological cut verifications across the interaction graph. Suspicious clusters resembling shifting sand on a dune trigger decentralized multi-agent audits. If Byzantine collusion is detected, validators slash the malicious cluster's stake with superlinear attacker cost scaling as O(n^2). Even if an adversary watches like a raven or relies on quartz clock timestamps to coordinate identity replication, honest cuts isolate and bankrupt Sybils.
